versions.subject: windows and linux python pty spawning
versions.detection:
selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
        - 'python.exe' # no \ bc of e.g. ipython.exe
        - 'python3.exe'
        - 'python2.exe'
selection_cli1:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'import pty'
        - '.spawn('
selection_cli2:
    CommandLine|contains: 'from pty import spawn'
condition: selection_image and 1 of selection_cli*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*python.exe", "*python3.exe", "*python2.exe") (CommandLine="*import pty*" CommandLine="*.spawn(*") OR CommandLine="*from pty import spawn*"
